Edits.description:
Operating-point edits applied before the model is built: demand deltas in MW
keyed by bus (the operating point is `base demand + delta`) and branch rating
deltas in MW keyed by branch (the thermal limit is `base rating + delta`). Keys
are [`ElementKey`]s — the original numeric id or the powerio row uid. A struct
(not a bare map) so the structural-edit vocabulary (add line, add generator,
retune a parameter) can grow without breaking the wire format: a client that
knows only `deltas` keeps working.

deltas.description: Active-power demand delta in MW per bus key.

rates.description:
Thermal rating delta in MW per branch key. Supported by the DC OPF
and SOCWR paths; the AC power flow has no flow limits and rejects them.

SensRequest.description:
One requested sensitivity cell: an [`Operand`] differentiated with respect to a
[`Parameter`], over an optional parameter-index subset, in an optional direction.
The operand/parameter are the public serde-tagged enums verbatim
(`{"Price":"Active"}` / `{"Demand":"Active"}`).

indices.description: Dense parameter-column indices; `None` computes the whole axis.

Mode.description:
Which linear systems the engine factorizes. [`Forward`](Mode::Forward) and
[`Adjoint`](Mode::Adjoint) return the same matrix; the choice trades a
factorization of `K` (cheap when parameters are few) for one of `K'` (cheap when
operands are few). [`Auto`](Mode::Auto) picks the smaller dimension and is the api
default.

oneOf.description: Solve `K X = rhs` once per parameter set, read the operand rows.
Solve `K' Y = S'` once per operand set, contract with `rhs`.

Pick [`Forward`](Mode::Forward) when parameters are at most operands, else
[`Adjoint`](Mode::Adjoint).

Operand.description:
What a sensitivity is taken *of*, named for the physical power quantity rather
than a formulation's internal variable. The orthogonal sub-axes (active/reactive,
from/to, voltage representation) are visible to the type system; each formulation
maps a request to its own KKT rows or returns [`SensError::Unsupported`].

The dialects fold into one vocabulary: DC `Angle` is `Voltage(Angle)`, the conic
squared magnitude `w` is `Voltage(Squared)`, the nodal price is `Price(Active)`.

oneOf.description:
Nodal-balance dual (the LMP for active power, the reactive price for
reactive), per bus.
Branch active/reactive flow at the from/to end, per branch.

Bus voltage in the formulation's representation (`vm` / `va` / `w` / `wr` /
`wi`), per bus.

Power.description:
Active or reactive power. The orthogonal P/Q sub-axis shared by prices,
dispatch, flows, and demand.

End.description: Which end of a branch a flow is measured at.

VoltageKind.description:
How a voltage operand is represented: polar (`Magnitude`, `Angle`) for the AC
power flow, or the W-space lift (`Squared` = `|V|²`, `ProductReal` = `Re(Vi Vj*)`,
`ProductImag` = `Im(Vi Vj*)`) for the conic relaxation.

Parameter.description:
What a sensitivity is taken *with respect to* — the parameter whose hand-derived
`dK/dp` column drives the solve.

oneOf.description: DC thermal limit `fmax` / AC-conic apparent-power `|S|` limit, per branch.
Voltage-magnitude bound right-hand side (the `w = |V|²` bound), per bus.

Generator output bound right-hand side (`pmax` / `pmin` / `qmax` / `qmin`),
per generator.
Transformer tap ratio / phase shift, per branch.
Branch switching state `sw` in `[0, 1]`, per branch.

A shift of both limits of a caller-supplied linear constraint (the
fixed value of an equality), per constraint in request order.

CostTerm.description: Which generation-cost coefficient: the quadratic `cq` or the linear `cl`.

GB.description: Conductance `g` or susceptance `b`, the real/imaginary parts of an admittance.

Bound.description: A min or max bound, e.g. the lower/upper voltage-magnitude limit.

TapKind.description: A transformer control: the tap ratio or the phase-shift angle.

CapacityPlanSpec.description:
The bounded decision space and search limits of one planning run. All
power quantities are MW.

budget_mw.description: Total intervention budget: `Σ_e increase_e` never exceeds it.

candidates.description: Candidate branches whose thermal ratings the search may increase.

exact_solve_budget.description:
Maximum number of exact OPF solves, including the baseline and every
accepted or rejected trial.

increment_mw.description: Discrete capacity increase considered in one trial.

max_changed_lines.description: Positive cardinality bound over the final proposal, not one iteration.

max_increase_per_branch_mw.description: Maximum cumulative increase for one branch.

ImplicitObjective.description:
A serializable outer objective over the optimal solve. Every
variant is a scalar with a well defined gradient through the KKT system;
new observables (generation, line loading, operating cost) add variants
rather than accepting code.

oneOf.description:
`Phi = Σ_b w_b · lmp_b` over the selected buses. Positive weights
make the search look for capacity increases that lower the weighted
marginal value of demand.

BusWeight.description: One bus term of a weighted objective, addressed by PowerIO bus ID.

BusId.description:
A source bus ID, preserved from the input format.

MATPOWER IDs are 1-based and can contain gaps. They are distinct from the
zero based dense indices produced by
[`IndexedNetwork::bus_index`](crate::IndexedNetwork::bus_index). JSON stores
this type as an integer.
